native_interfaces.name: ZCodeApp runtime event subscription
native_interfaces.contract: ZCodeApp exposes runtime: AgentRuntime; subscribe as app.runtime.subscribeEvents({ onSessionEvent(event) { ... } }); it returns an unsubscribe function. The native event envelope carries sessionId, optional turnId, type, timestamp, traceId, sequenceNumber, and payload.

native_interfaces.name: ZCodeApp submitPrompt
native_interfaces.contract: submitPrompt(prompt, options?) returns TurnResult with response, turnId, traceId, optional usage, native events, and SessionProjection. It has no separate business-success field.

native_interfaces.name: ZCodeApp.loadSessionTranscript
native_interfaces.arguments: None; the facade binds deps.sessionId and deps.sessionStore.
native_interfaces.data_source: loadSessionTranscriptFromStore calls sessionStore.messages({ sessionID: sessionId }); if the optional SessionStorePort is absent it returns an empty array.

output_schema.message: SessionTranscriptMessage { content: string; parts?: SessionTranscriptPart[]; role: 'agent' | 'user' }
part_variants: tool { input, output?, error?, resultDisplay?, status: pending|running|completed|failed, title?, toolCallId, toolName }

mapping_behavior: Filters summary messages and model-only user messages.
User messages become role user, using non-ignored text/file/agent parts.
Assistant messages become role agent; non-ignored text parts are joined with blank lines, reasoning becomes thought, and tool parts retain status plus input and output/error.
The returned transcript messages do not carry message IDs, turn IDs, event sequence numbers, or receipt provenance.
native_interfaces.consequence: This is a useful existing history/UI restoration API, correcting the earlier claim that ZCodeApp exposed no transcript read. U07 live projection still does not need a new history API: subscribeEvents and TurnResult provide current-turn facts. The transcript is a persisted conversation projection, not a replacement for correlated live receipts; do not treat its retained tool text as a fresh current-turn execution proof.

native_interfaces.name: Underlying native session store
native_interfaces.contract: SessionStorePort.messages({ sessionID }) returns MessageWithParts[]; stored assistant messages use role assistant and structured text/reasoning/tool parts. The public app transcript maps the stored assistant role to agent and omits storage identifiers.

fields: Use sessionId and turnId to scope current-turn events.
Use inputId when present to associate accepted input.
Use sequenceNumber for event order and id or (sessionId, sequenceNumber) for idempotency.
correlation_and_ordering.duplicate_sources: Choose runtime subscription for live UI/projection. If a caller also merges TurnResult.events, deduplicate before reduction.

tool_lifecycle.payload: Scheduled and started carry toolCallId and toolName; progress carries toolCallId and may omit toolName.
tool_lifecycle.projection: Create or update one pending/running receipt keyed by toolCallId.

tool_lifecycle.payload: toolCallId, result.success/content/display/perf/truncation/byte metadata, duration; event payload itself has no toolName.
tool_lifecycle.projection: Terminal success is success=true; join the tool name from scheduled/started by toolCallId.

tool_lifecycle.payload: toolCallId plus structured ErrorPayload; event payload itself has no toolName.
tool_lifecycle.projection: Terminal failure for that toolCallId; retain only allowlisted/sanitized error type or code for evidence.
Use as batch aggregate/cross-check, not as a substitute for per-tool terminal receipts.

event_projection.sanitization: Do not persist raw input, result content, stack, or the whole native payload in the product evidence projection; tool inputs/results can be large or sensitive. Project the minimal correlated facts: IDs, name, terminal state, success, and a safe error classification.

authoritative_current_turn_text.source: TurnResult.response and the matching turn_complete payload.response
authoritative_current_turn_text.rule: Render/preserve the native final response directly; do not invoke another model to rewrite it. Do not combine every ModelComplete or streaming chunk into the final reply; modelResponse is updated on each model step and the loop's returned response is the terminal value.
authoritative_current_turn_text.behavior: Native UI uses ModelStreaming assistantMessageId for live text, appends TurnResult.response for submit calls, and applies non-empty turn_complete.response as an idempotent fallback when streaming/result application did not already show it. The transcript display role is agent.

business_completion_boundary.rule: Turn lifecycle success is not proof that the requested task succeeded. Expose native turn outcome and actual tool receipts separately; only declare a business requirement verified when its declared evidence is present and correlated.

business_completion_boundary.cancellation: TurnCancelled is represented as TurnComplete { response: '', resultType: 'cancelled' }, not TurnError. A cancelled tool can have a per-tool error receipt; retain earlier successful receipts and mark the aggregate partial/cancelled as appropriate.
business_completion_boundary.caution: Native UI/event reducers use TurnComplete to finish the interaction (idle/ready); that UI lifecycle transition is not business verification.

u06_minimum_interface_requirements: Expose and use the same pinned app.runtime.subscribeEvents sink plus unsubscribe and app.submitPrompt result; preserve the native ZCode Runtime/Loop.
Register event subscription before calling submitPrompt so the current Hook/turn events are not missed; preserve sessionId, turnId, inputId, toolCallId, event id/sequence, and Hook terminal events.

Bind the loaded ContextPacket to the submitted turn and expose only safe local provenance such as identity/version/digest for projection joins; pinned SessionEvent has no ContextPacket identifier field, so U06 must supply that join explicitly if needed.
Report Hook packet load failure/blocked state explicitly; do not infer it by parsing the reply text.
Keep role prompt content out of receipts and do not add a second autonomous Loop or pure persona rewrite model call.
tests_recommended: Pure reducer fixture: one successful native tool receipt plus native final response.
ToolCallError followed by TurnComplete success: preserve failure and do not mark business result verified.
hook_run_blocked / UserPromptSubmit preventContinuation followed by TurnComplete success: classify blocked or unverified.
A batch with one successful and one failed tool: retain both per-tool receipts and reconcile ToolBatchComplete counts.
TurnComplete cancelled after a successful receipt: keep the prior success and mark the current outcome cancelled/partial.
Duplicate/out-of-order events: order by sequenceNumber and reduce idempotently; verify TurnResult.events plus live subscription do not double-append.
Streaming final text plus turn_complete fallback: avoid duplicate transcript reply and ignore empty cancellation response.
